--- webhooks.md ---
# Working with Webhooks

To receive events, create a subscription pointing at your URL. Lumen tracks each delivery attempt separately, and retries a failed delivery attempt up to 5 times with exponential backoff.

Your subscription can filter by event type, so you only receive the events you care about.

--- retries.md ---
# Retry Behavior

If a delivery attempt returns a non-2xx status, Lumen schedules another delivery attempt. After 5 failed delivery attempts, the subscription is marked as degraded and Lumen sends you an email.

A degraded subscription is one that has failed its last 5 consecutive delivery attempts.

--- concepts.md ---
# Lumen Core Concepts

A subscription is a standing request to receive events matching a filter. Lumen represents each attempt to deliver an event to your subscription's URL as a delivery attempt. Every event you send has an event type, which is a string like `order.created` that tells Lumen (and your webhook handler) what kind of event it is.
